request.briefing_text:
# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 OTE | Reports to Partnerships (partner GTM context) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s enterprise opportunity depends on making Claude useful in production environments through organizations with customer access, implementation depth, and industry credibility.

The central challenge is expanding partner-delivered adoption without creating an overly customized services model. Success likely requires a common operating system for technical qualification, solution validation, enablement, governance,
and field-to-product learning.

This position sits where commercial scale, technical rigor, and responsible deployment meet. The strongest impact will come from making partner execution easier to reproduce while maintaining a high bar for customer outcomes.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation focused on advanced AI research and products. Its company identity centers on building AI that is reliable, interpretable, steerable, safe, accurate, and secure.

Its enterprise footprint includes Claude for individual and organizational users, Claude Enterprise, and developer-oriented API access. These surfaces create different adoption paths, from knowledge work and coding support to embedded
application experiences and governed company-wide usage.

That breadth makes implementation quality strategically important. Customers and partners need to connect model capability to business processes, security expectations, employee adoption, and sustained operational ownership.

Anthropic’s commercial model must balance speed with trust. Partner delivery can broaden enterprise reach substantially, but every route to market must preserve consistent expectations around technical integrity and responsible use.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, Anthropic combines frontier-model development with a public commitment to safety and reliability. That commitment is relevant to enterprise growth because deployment confidence is part
of the product value proposition.

Claude is presented as an AI assistant for complex work, including analysis, writing, coding, and problem solving. The broad applicability expands the potential market, while increasing the need to distinguish durable workflow value from
generic experimentation.

Enterprise success is likely determined after initial access is granted. Technical configuration, organizational launch, user behavior, and continued improvement all affect realized value. This creates pressure to clarify which deployment
methods are standardized, which can be partner-owned, and which observations should directly inform product decisions.

A scalable ecosystem will require disciplined choices about where to invest technical capacity. The key question is not whether partners can create demand, but whether they can repeatedly guide customers toward credible, sustainable usage.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Daniela Amodei is co-founder and president. Anthropic’s public framing places safety, reliability, and societal benefit alongside product advancement and growth.

Relevant stakeholders likely span:
- Product and engineering groups, which need structured evidence from deployments instead of disconnected feature requests.
- Enterprise and developer-facing product organizations, which support both business adoption and technical integration.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Anthropic offers Claude through user-facing experiences, enterprise products, and APIs. This creates an architectural spectrum that ranges from individual assistance to managed organizational environments and application-level
integration.

Claude Enterprise emphasizes security, compliance, and support for business and technical teams. For a partner ecosystem, that means a compelling demonstration is insufficient; solution quality must account for access controls, operating
processes, adoption planning, and real business workflows.

Claude’s positioning around data work, software development, writing, and complex reasoning gives partners a wide opportunity set. The scalable path is likely to identify a smaller number of high-confidence patterns that can be adapted by
industry rather than repeatedly starting from first principles.

Architecture leadership in this environment should translate model capabilities into practical decision frameworks: where AI is appropriate, how value is measured, what users need to change, and how deployments can improve over time.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic describes an ecosystem of cloud, technology, and services partners that helps customers address AI challenges. This indicates that alliances are a meaningful enterprise distribution and implementation route.

The ecosystem contains several complementary contributions:
- Technology partners can connect Claude with existing enterprise applications, data environments, and workflow systems.
- Joint offerings can package recurring customer needs into more reusable implementation approaches.

Large services partners can extend reach across many client situations, but scale also introduces consistency risk. A mature motion will need clear standards for technical readiness, customer handoffs, solution review, and partner learning.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s enterprise materials separate implementation from user adoption and continued improvement. This signals that the company recognizes value realization as an ongoing operating discipline rather than a one-time deployment
event.

The expanding ecosystem raises the importance of establishing shared methods before delivery practices diverge across partners and regions. Inconsistent solution approaches can create avoidable friction for customers and make it harder to
identify recurring platform needs.

Enterprise AI competition increases the premium on demonstrable outcomes. Buyers can access many models and tools; the differentiator increasingly becomes whether a provider and its ecosystem can help them move from interest to trusted,
repeatable use.

Anthropic has an opportunity to create a reinforcing loop: better partner preparation improves customer outcomes, stronger customer evidence improves solution patterns, and clearer patterns create more effective product and ecosystem
investment.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Designing scalable technical partner motions rather than relying on ad hoc support for a small set of strategic accounts.
- Turning deployment learning into reusable playbooks, solution patterns, and partner education.
- Leading technical practitioners in ambiguous, rapidly changing markets while maintaining quality and customer trust.
- Connecting commercial priorities with product, engineering, security, and customer-adoption considerations.
- Creating disciplined technical engagement methods across cloud, services, and technology partner channels.
- Improving enterprise value realization through implementation planning, user activation, and ongoing optimization.
- Translating advanced AI capabilities into specific business workflows, industry contexts, and measurable outcomes.
- Coaching senior customer-facing technical talent that must influence executives, delivery teams, and internal builders.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Strong ecosystem programs connect commercial activity, solution development, technical validation, customer adoption, and product learning.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims, outcomes, leadership scope, technical depth, partnerships, and metrics must come from the governed resume/proof graph.

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD
